import unittest
from solution import privileged_tasks


class PrivilegedTasksTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_full_case_insensitive_owner_match(self):
        members = [" Alice ", "BOB", "", "   "]
        tasks = [
            "1|alice|Deploy",
            "2 | Bob | Review ",
            "3|malice|Must not match",
            "4|bobby|Must not match",
            "5|ALICE|Again",
        ]
        self.assertEqual(privileged_tasks(members, tasks), [
            {"pid": 1, "owner": "alice", "name": "Deploy"},
            {"pid": 2, "owner": "Bob", "name": "Review"},
            {"pid": 5, "owner": "ALICE", "name": "Again"},
        ])

    def test_malformed_task_lines_are_skipped_and_duplicates_preserved(self):
        task = "007 | root | audit"
        tasks = [task, "bad", "1|root", "x|root|job", "2||job", "3|root|", "4|root|job|extra", task]
        self.assertEqual(privileged_tasks(["root"], tasks), [
            {"pid": 7, "owner": "root", "name": "audit"},
            {"pid": 7, "owner": "root", "name": "audit"},
        ])

    def test_empty_usable_collections(self):
        self.assertEqual(privileged_tasks([], ["1|a|x"]), [])
        self.assertEqual(privileged_tasks([" ", "\t"], ["1|a|x"]), [])
        self.assertEqual(privileged_tasks(["a"], []), [])
        self.assertEqual(privileged_tasks(["a"], ["bad", "x|a|task"]), [])

    def test_invalid_inputs(self):
        for members, tasks in (("a", []), ([], "1|a|x"), ([1], []), ([], [None]), (("a",), (1,))):
            with self.subTest(members=members, tasks=tasks):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    privileged_tasks(members, tasks)

    def test_fresh_dicts_and_no_mutation(self):
        members = ["a"]
        tasks = ["1|a|x"]
        members_before = members[:]
        tasks_before = tasks[:]
        first = privileged_tasks(members, tasks)
        first[0]["name"] = "changed"
        second = privileged_tasks(members, tasks)
        self.assertEqual(second, [{"pid": 1, "owner": "a", "name": "x"}])
        self.assertEqual(members, members_before)
        self.assertEqual(tasks, tasks_before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
